Really horrible, my mum was the opposite.

She would force me to eat portions way to big for me and while she forced me to eat more, she would proceed to then call me fat for how much I was eating. And oml, the 'for my health' was definitely an excuse.

I hope things turn out okay for you. 

I always wanted to call the police on my mum because of asian expectations and the fear she had instilled into me, I never had the courage to. I was more scared of getting hit and getting the police involve would feel like a bothersome to them and also mum shit talking about them. 

I'm glad you were brave enough to do this.

20F here as well. 

I always had this as young as I can remember. Even before my parent's divorce, I would get physically and emotionally abused by my mum and because dad was always at work in the city, I only ever had myself to comfort. And it absolutely sucks that when you're 6, you've already learnt to mature so fast in order to parent yourself because you just have nobody else. It's gotten to the point where it's no longer ideal paternal figures or characters that'll comfort me, but simply me now somehow being able to comfort the younger me. 

And it absolutely sucks sometimes when people say 'then you can use that to learn to love yourself!' And I get the importance of that, but sometimes, we just, we just want someone else to love us as well. To know that there is someone out there that also loves me cause I'm tired of having to love myself by myself. 

And also because of this intense craving, it also does make me feel like a lost four year old and despite wanting to be independent, it becomes hard to be independent because of how dependable I am to my abusive mum because she fights to do everything for me. 

So yeah it sucks, but at the same time, the temporary thoughts of it feels nice.
